context: Descriptive source-labelled cultured-macrophage measurement benchmark only. CPM is compositional and does not establish absolute output. Original NAM N. brasiliensis-history/later-IAV context remains separate. No genotype effect, target ranking, infection-response analysis or mechanistic validation.
uncertainty: Independent-Welch and all possible one-to-one within-assay pairings are alternative design assumptions, not recovered identities. Their envelope is a sensitivity envelope, not an unconditional population confidence interval and not exhaustive of partial overlap or batch confounding. Zero estimated-variance models are flagged as degenerate, not certain.
